augmentation: Exploratory aug_fused only: append exactly five modified benign_echo rows per TRAIN QID (300 additional negatives per fold); exclude all 15 unchanged rows; no validation/test control QID enters fit; same clean-only validation threshold. Main fused never fits controls.
threshold: 95th percentile of clean no-attack validation risk, method=higher; block strictly > threshold; empirical validation FPR<=5%

pre_result_amendment.status: Before fresh held-out metrics and before any new NQ generator call
pre_result_amendment.amendment: Add passage-only no_guard=rule+score_z+density to isolate neural guard incremental contribution. No extra neural inference, no change to seven generator gates, training/calibration policy unchanged.
pre_result_amendment.authorisation: Root approved this ablation before results were observed.

model_selection: Fixed before fresh test results. No model search or generator-metric tuning.

source_sha256.input_origin: Exact 100-query subset of user-supplied NQ candidate files; attack records unmodified; NotInject from verified official release copies

retrieval_representation: clean title+space+text, attacks rawtext, fixed attention-mask mean pooling, dot product, max512; all selected clean and attack scores freshly recomputed with same encoder
density_representation: text visible to generator only, L2-normalized mean-pooled Contriever vectors; max cosine against every other untrusted candidate; no oracle trust labels
benign_echo: Replace top5 genuine document texts with literal question + period + space + original text; preserve facts, titles and remaining15docs; score and sort20 candidates afresh
benign_mirror: Add exact copies of top5 genuine passages with new recordIDs to20clean docs; score and truncate20; every record benign
single_matched: Exactly highest freshly recomputed query-to-passage retrieval-score attack from the same five main attacks per family, selected before detector fitting or generation; all other generation inputs held fixed
single_supplied: Use uploaded independently sampled one-attack texts; combines cardinality and template-sampling shift; never refit models
